purpose: Teach: 後述/費やす/沿う/起点/厳正/一味/ナマ/言い換え

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査報告書の後述部分が重要です
lines.en: The details in the latter part of the investigation report are what matter most.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slight pause after opening phrase to establish gravity. Clear enunciation on key terms. Steady eye contact—this is information being transferred with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、長期捜査に時間を費やすご苦労、感謝しております
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the time and effort your department has put into this lengthy investigation.
lines.style: Respectful, deliberate. Lean slightly forward on 'grateful'—genuine appreciation without obsequiousness. Steady, careful pacing. The formality of someone speaking to an authority figure he trusts.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、法令に沿う捜査を徹底します
lines.en: We will ensure our investigation adheres strictly to the law at every step.
lines.style: Formal, declarative. Crisp attack on the opening. No inflection—just commitment. Slow, weighted pace. The tone of someone stating an institutional promise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、事件の起点をご解明されたんですね
lines.en: I see. So you've been able to clarify the origin of the incident itself.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly impressed. Uptick on the realization—'I see'—like a piece clicking into place. Thoughtful pause before the second clause. Genuine curiosity underneath the formal register.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、内部処分は厳正に行います
lines.en: We will conduct internal disciplinary measures with the utmost rigor.
lines.style: Firm, uncompromising. Weighted pause before 'rigor.' No apology in the tone—just assertion of standards. Measured breathing. The voice of institutional accountability.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪一味の全容を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. You're systematically investigating the full scope of the criminal network involved.
lines.style: Acknowledging nod in the voice. Slight lift of respect on 'systematically.' Warm undertone—recognition of thoroughness. Steady pace, almost conversational despite the formal context.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ナマの証拠映像を確保しました
lines.en: We have secured raw footage evidence from the scene.
lines.style: Direct, factual. Weight on 'secured'—this is a concrete achievement. No flourish. Slow cadence. The voice of someone listing a significant fact without embellishment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、難しい捜査用語を市民向けに言い換えていらっしゃいますね
lines.en: Yes. I notice you've been translating the more technical investigative terminology into language civilians can actually understand.
lines.style: Warm, almost gentle observation. Slight smile in the tone—genuine appreciation for the effort. Slower pace, more natural. A moment of human recognition within the formal exchange.
